study: NVFP4 reference extension of the BF16/FP8 neuron sparsity pilot

fp4.recipe: released NVFP4 weights plus published locally dynamic 4-bit activation scheme; selected linear layers only

execution.matmul: BF16 grouped_mm; no native FP4 GEMMs
execution.weight_decode: official CT E2M1 unpack and dequantization, returning BF16 values
execution.activations: official CT dynamic local scale computation and fake_quantize, per released expert/projection global scale
execution.extra_rounding_caveat: Decoding operands to BF16 before GEMMs may differ from scale handling and accumulation in native FP4 kernels. Native parity has not been established.
execution.vision: text only; released checkpoint omits visual tower

intervention.point: SwiGLU output of routed experts, before down projection activation quantization
intervention.score: absolute activation multiplied by router weight
intervention.adaptive: top 320 of 8 x 512 = 4096 routed neuron activations per token/layer; routing remains free
intervention.transfer: BF16 clean top-320 neuron identities intersected with available FP4 clean routes
intervention.matched_native: first m FP4 clean top-320 identities, where m is the number of available transferred identities
intervention.matched_random: random m of 4096 available activations, fixed seed by layer/window
intervention.frozen: transfer, matched_native and matched_random use the same FP4 clean expert indices and router weights throughout
intervention.shared_experts: quantized as specified by the release; their neuron activations are not pruned

limits: 32 short Wikipedia passages, not a broad capability benchmark
Calibration publisher and recipe change along with precision
Reference execution does not validate native kernel behavior or deployment savings
No semantic interpretation or judge-model claims in this extension
